name: zindex_archive_open_file_by_name
description: zIndexArchive::OpenFileByName finds a ZAR record by case-insensitive name, publishes its size, seeks to its payload offset, and returns the archive file handle.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 byte verification for 0x4a6630 through the zindex_archive_open_file_by_name target passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a6630 validates FindRecordByNameCI dispatch, INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE return for a missing record, optional *outSize assignment from record->fileSize, SetFilePointer(hFile, record->fileOffset, 0, FILE_BEGIN), and returning hFile.

The native archive-loading smoke mounts an index archive, verifies OpenFileByName returns the backing file handle and publishes record->fileSize for a named payload, then loads the archived ZRDR node through the mounted archive path.
